alt: A cluster of clear quartz crystals with purple-dipped bases sits in a glossy pool of swirling purple and white resin.
A decorative night light features a glowing green heron in flight against a circular translucent backdrop, accompanied by a 3D white bamboo sculpture on a cream-colored base.
A round, glossy glass paperweight features a floral design with purple and pink blossoms and green leaves set against a dark background.
A colorful glass sculpture of tulips featuring vibrant blue, green, and rainbow hues, with intricate details and a glossy finish.
A clear glass turtle figurine with red speckles on its limbs and a shell filled with colorful rolled paper quilling in pink, blue, and green.
A decorative glass tray features a printed design of a koi fish swimming among pebbles, lily pads, and a pink water lily.
A sculpted bonsai-style tree with a white, gnarled trunk and vibrant red, textured foliage sits atop a bright green base adorned with smooth, grey stones.
A small glass figurine of a sea turtle features a translucent body with blue-tinted flippers and a vibrant, multicolored shell decorated with purple, red, green, and blue speckles.
A translucent green glass paperweight featuring a spherical top with embedded blue flowers, resting on a base of sculpted green leaves with gold accents.
A translucent blue glass sculpture featuring a painted tree with intricate, colorful swirling patterns in the background, mounted on a matching blue glass base.
A translucent blue and green resin sculpture featuring a painted white and purple lotus flower with a yellow center, resting on a wooden surface.
A white ceramic swan figurine sits on a marbled red and purple circular base, accompanied by three heart-shaped resin decorations in varying shades of red and gold.

A Halloween-themed resin figurine features a glowing green crystal ball with a haunted house silhouette, held by twisted dark branches, and sits above an illuminated jack-o'-lantern on a wooden base surrounded by colorful gems.
A sepia-toned pencil sketch depicts a bald chef in a white coat holding a bottle labeled "Soy Sauce for Cake" and a whisk, flanked by two smiling women and two squirrels.
A clear resin sea turtle figurine with a shell filled with pink, blue, and green paper quilling roses, featuring red speckled flippers and a black bead eye, resting on a blue resin base.
A rustic wooden rocking horse with a live-edge seat and natural wood grain sits on a dining table.
A small figurine of a cat wearing a blue jacket and a colorful hat holds a tiny origami boat made from a dollar bill.

A rectangular block of clear resin encapsulates a painted autumn scene featuring white birch trees with black markings, surrounded by vibrant red, orange, and yellow foliage against a dark background.
A handcrafted bonsai-style tree sculpture features a twisted copper-colored wire trunk and branches adorned with clusters of blue and purple quartz crystals, mounted on a white rectangular base.
A clear glass paperweight encasing a detailed orange and red flower surrounded by green leaves.
A handcrafted fused glass art piece featuring white birch trees with black markings set against a vibrant, abstract background of red, purple, and blue hues.
A vibrant, textured painting of a red-and-blue macaw perched on a branch against a swirled green and yellow background.
A painting of a gnarled, leafless brown tree with twisted branches set against a vibrant, textured background of vertical rainbow-colored paint drips.
